+Set OPENAI_API_KEY, then run:
+    python3 openai_client.py --model YOUR_MODEL < prompt.txt
+
+Or import send_prompt(prompt, model=\"YOUR_MODEL\") for the full response,
+and output_text(response) for assistant text. Prompts are read from stdin,
+never command-line arguments. This module does not log or persist prompts,
+keys, or responses. CLI output goes to stdout, which callers may capture.

+Disabling response storage does not guarantee zero provider retention;

+import urllib.request
+
+
+RESPONSES_URL = \"https://api.openai.com/v1/responses\"
+
+
+class OpenAIError(RuntimeError):
+    \"\"\"A sanitized failure that does not include prompts or response bodies.\"\"\"
+
+    def __init__(self, message, *, status_code=None):
+        super().__init__(message)
+        self.status_code = status_code
+
+
+class _NoRedirects(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler):
+    def redirect_request(self, request, file_pointer, code, message, headers,
+                         new_url):
+        return None
+
+
+def send_prompt(prompt, *, model, api_key=None, timeout=60.0):
+    \"\"\"Send one text prompt; return the decoded Responses API JSON object.
+
+    The key defaults to OPENAI_API_KEY. No automatic retries, conversation
+    history, tools, background processing, or local persistence are used.
+    Errors are sanitized; HTTP failures expose only the status code.
+    \"\"\"
+    if not isinstance(prompt, str) or not prompt.strip():
+        raise ValueError(\"prompt must be a nonempty string\")
+    if not isinstance(model, str) or not model.strip():
+        raise ValueError(\"model must be a nonempty string\")
+    if (isinstance(timeout, bool) or not isinstance(timeout, (int, float))
+            or not math.isfinite(timeout) or timeout <= 0):
+        raise ValueError(\"timeout must be a finite positive number\")
+    key = api_key if api_key is not None else os.environ.get(\"OPENAI_API_KEY\")
+    if not isinstance(key, str) or not key.strip():
+        raise ValueError(\"Set OPENAI_API_KEY or supply api_key\")
+    if any(ord(character) < 33 or ord(character) > 126 for character in key):
+        raise ValueError(\"api_key must contain only printable non-space ASCII\")
+
+    body = json.dumps({\"model\": model, \"input\": prompt, \"store\": False}).encode(
+        \"utf-8\"
+    )
+    request = urllib.request.Request(
+        RESPONSES_URL,
+        data=body,
+        headers={
+            \"Authorization\": \"Bearer \" + key,
+            \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\",
+            \"Accept\": \"application/json\",
+        },
+        method=\"POST\",
+    )
+    opener = urllib.request.build_opener(
+        urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}), _NoRedirects()
+    )
+    try:
+        with opener.open(request, timeout=timeout) as response:
+            result = json.loads(response.read().decode(\"utf-8\"))
+    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
+        status_code = error.code
+        error.close()
+        raise OpenAIError(
+            \"OpenAI request failed (HTTP {}).\".format(status_code),
+            status_code=status_code,
+        ) from None
+    except (urllib.error.URLError, OSError, ValueError):
+        raise OpenAIError(\"OpenAI connection failed or response was invalid.\") from None
+    if not isinstance(result, dict):
+        raise OpenAIError(\"OpenAI returned an invalid response object.\")
+    if result.get(\"error\") or result.get(\"status\") == \"failed\":
+        raise OpenAIError(\"OpenAI could not complete the response.\")
+    return result
+
+
+def output_text(response):
+    \"\"\"Concatenate assistant output_text blocks, ignoring other output types.
+
+    Inspect the full response for refusals or incomplete generation details.
+    \"\"\"
+    return \"\".join(
+        content[\"text\"]
+        for item in response.get(\"output\", [])
+        if item.get(\"type\") == \"message\" and item.get(\"role\") == \"assistant\"
+        for content in item.get(\"content\", [])
+        if content.get(\"type\") == \"output_text\"
+        and isinstance(content.get(\"text\"), str)
+    )
+
+
+def main(argv=None):
+    \"\"\"Read a prompt from stdin and print only the assistant's text.\"\"\"
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument(\"--model\", required=True, help=\"Responses-compatible model ID\")
+    parser.add_argument(\"--timeout\", type=float, default=60.0, help=\"Timeout in seconds\")
+    arguments = parser.parse_args(argv)
+    if sys.stdin.isatty():
+        print(\"Provide the prompt through piped or redirected stdin.\", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+    try:
+        response = send_prompt(
+            sys.stdin.read(), model=arguments.model, timeout=arguments.timeout
+        )
+        text = output_text(response)
+        if not text:
+            raise OpenAIError(\"OpenAI returned no assistant text.\")
+        print(text)
+        if response.get(\"status\") == \"incomplete\":
+            print(\"OpenAI returned an incomplete response.\", file=sys.stderr)
+            return 1
+    except (OpenAIError, ValueError) as error:
+        print(str(error), file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+    except OSError:
+        print(\"Could not read input or write output.\", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+    except KeyboardInterrupt:
+        return 130
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == \"__main__\":
+    sys.exit(main())

PATCH"
